comment: Primary model contract is fixed to the official OwensLab Community Forensics 384px checkpoint. Preprocessing is settled on official-center (Resize440+CenterCrop384). The provenance audit is owner-approved and the INT8 comparison passes at its documented 0.25 p99 limit, but the frozen native-format nuisance battery fails. url therefore remains null and the fused curve remains quarantined; publication readiness is separate from the preprocessing choice.

models.notes: Official 21.8M-parameter Community Forensics ViT-S. Shipped preprocessing is the authors' Resize(440 short edge) + CenterCrop(384) evaluation transform (tiling.mode official-center, single crop, no tile voting). Measured on the web-realistic replica this on-distribution input beats native tile voting (pooled held-out BA 0.833 vs 0.813 native-max; lowres TPR 0.76 vs 0.64) and is ~2.5x faster. The hash and size identify the reproducibly exported INT8 browser artifact. url remains null because the frozen native-format B1-B5 permutation battery and paired detector-minus-null gate fail; provenance and INT8 precision are no longer blockers. No CommunityForensics dataset is downloaded or reused.
